Sure! Here's your silly poem:

A cat named Whiskers, with whiskers so sharp,
Had a car that was sleek and smooth.
He drove it to the store, where he bought some snacks,
But when he got home, he found his car had broken down.

So Whiskers went back to the store, to fix his car,
And while he was there, he met a pretty lady.
She asked him what he did with his cat,
And Whiskers told her about his silly adventure.
